article.headline: 84% of Wedding Vendors Are Invisible in AI. Here's How to Fix That.
article.description: The 5W AI Visibility Index 2026 found 84% of individual wedding vendors don't appear in AI-generated answers. Here's the practical playbook to fix that — starting this week.
